lines.text: Jesus tells His disciples to be dressed for service like servants waiting for their master to return from a wedding banquet.
The master finds his servants on watch, even in the second or third watch, and he gives each one a bag of silver.

wrong_details.wrong: He gives each one a bag of silver
wrong_details.true: He dresses himself to serve, has them recline at the table, and waits on them

lines.text: Jesus says the Son of Man will come at an unexpected hour, and Peter asks if the parable is for them or for everyone.
The faithful and wise manager gives the servants their portion on time, and the master puts him in charge of all his possessions.
The manager who says his master will be home before dawn begins beating the servants, and the master comes at an hour he expects.

wrong_details.wrong: His master will be home before dawn
wrong_details.true: His master will be a long time in coming
on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate
